explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. The theorem is about `TauCeti.evalIntBivariateSeries`, which the library defines itself (line 245 of the same file) by evaluating an integer power series in two variables one variable at a time. The theorem rewrites that evaluation as a single sum over ℕ × ℕ. Its content depends on the library's definition and on its own summability lemmas, `summable_norm_intCast_mul_pow_mul_pow` and `summable_intCast_mul_pow`. The proof combines these with generic Mathlib lemmas about infinite sums (`Summable.tsum_mul_right`, `Summable.tsum_comm`, `Summable.tsum_prod`). None of those generic lemmas carries the result on its own, and Mathlib has no way to evaluate an integer power series in two variables at points of an ultrametric ring. I did not run a separate search of Mathlib, because the statement is about the library's own definition.
